title: Grilled Anticuchos with Peruvian-Style Sauce
description: A traditional Peruvian dish featuring grilled beef heart skewers served with a tangy and creamy sauce. Perfect for a quick and flavorful meal.
instructions: 2. Thread beef heart cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
3. Brush skewers with oil and season with salt and pepper.
4. Grill skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
5. Meanwhile, heat aji amarillo sauce in a saucepan over medium heat.
6. Add sliced red onion and red bell pepper to the saucepan and cook until tender.
7. Stir in chopped cilantro, garlic, and soy sauce (if using).
8. Serve grilled anticuchos with peruvian-style sauce and a squeeze of lime juice.
